compiled_state.title: Implement size_action=upgrade routing to deep tier in ci-llm-review-runner.sh
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD3: ci-llm-review-runner.sh reads size_action from the classifier JSON output; when size_action=upgrade, routes to the deep tier model.
- DD4: A diff of any size is reviewed without error — there is no hard line-count cap that causes the runner to exit early or skip review.

## What to implement
In plugins/dso/scripts/ci-llm-review-runner.sh, after the SELECTED_TIER extraction (around line 61), add a SIZE_ACTION extraction and tier override:

```bash
SELECTED_TIER=$(printf '%s\n' "$CLASSIFIER_JSON" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['selected_tier'])")

# Extract size_action; when "upgrade", override tier to deep regardless of selected_tier.
# This mirrors local REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md Step 3b REVIEW_AGENT_OVERRIDE behavior.
SIZE_ACTION=$(printf '%s\n' "$CLASSIFIER_JSON" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('size_action','none'))")
if [[ "$SIZE_ACTION" == "upgrade" ]]; then
    SELECTED_TIER="deep"
fi
```

That's the complete implementation. Place the SIZE_ACTION block immediately after the SELECTED_TIER line (before the overlay flag extraction block).

IMPORTANT: "warn" does NOT change SELECTED_TIER — it only emits SIZE_WARNING to stderr in the classifier. The runner ignores "warn" (just proceeds normally).

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/ci-llm-review-runner.sh: modify (~5 lines added after line 61)
- tests/scripts/test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh: the RED tests from Task 3 should now pass

## Acceptance Criteria

  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh 2>&1 | grep -E "PASS|FAIL" | tail -5
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)

- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] SIZE_ACTION extraction exists after SELECTED_TIER extraction
  Verify: grep -q 'SIZE_ACTION' plugins/dso/scripts/ci-llm-review-runner.sh
- [ ] When size_action=upgrade is injected, SELECTED_TIER becomes deep
  Verify: grep -A3 'SIZE_ACTION' plugins/dso/scripts/ci-llm-review-runner.sh | grep -q 'SELECTED_TIER="deep"'
- [ ] test_runner_size_action_upgrade_overrides_to_deep_tier passes (RED → GREEN)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh 2>&1 | grep 'test_runner_size_action_upgrade_overrides_to_deep_tier.*PASS'
- [ ] test_runner_size_action_warn_does_not_block passes (RED → GREEN)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh 2>&1 | grep 'test_runner_size_action_warn_does_not_block.*PASS'
